body.hypothesis: Adding WITHIN-USER relative context features (each impression's duration percentile inside that user's own impression list, its signed deviation from the user's median duration, the user's impression count bucket, and the item's position-in-user-session rank bucket) lifts dev primary by 0.004-0.010 over the champion's absolute-value fields.
body.mechanism: The metric is purely within-user ranking, so only variation ACROSS a user's own impressions can move GAUC/nDCG@5. The champion encodes duration and profile counters as absolute buckets; every user then shares the same global bucket-to-score mapping, and a user who only ever sees short videos gets no discriminative signal.
